data.animaCaption: Leaning lightly across the closed Café Stella marble counter in her signature brown suspender uniform, she slides a steaming mug of hot cocoa toward you with a quiet blush. Warm brass pendant bulbs glow across the rising steam while rain streams down the blue-lit front window behind her.
data.promptProse: Framed across a steaming ceramic mug of hot cocoa in the foreground on the polished marble counter of Café Stella after hours, Shiki Natsume wears her canonical waitress uniform—crisp white shirt, purple ribbon tie, brown suspender skirt, and floral hair clip. Leaning slightly forward as she pushes the warm mug toward the viewer, she lets a quiet, unmistakable warmth soften her amber eyes beneath the intimate amber glow of hanging brass pendant lamps while cool blue rain runs down the dark streetfront windows.
data.story: 门上的营业牌翻到了闭店那一面，外头正下着秋雨。夏目什么也没问，只把一杯刚拉好花、热气腾腾的可可推到你面前，指尖在杯壁轻轻一敲——「淋成这样还跑过来，先把这杯喝完再说正事。」
